column1: # Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Nintendo EPD Tokyo's engine (al / sead / agl, NintendoWare) on SDK 8.2.0, update 1.4.2 with both DLC packs; 7,258 shaders, all translated (the fin fur geometry shader too:
# the Adreno 830 reports geometry shaders). Handheld as the profile's op_mode says: the game's pointer is the touch screen there, so the pause menu's default is handheld too.
# Tested 2026-10-29 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), driven with DM_CTL: a new save starts in the opening course (Toad, Toadette, the
# Power Star on the temple): walking, the camera turned all round and from above, the course's pause menu, Toad's silhouette drawn through a wall that hides him.
# 60 fps as on the Switch (frame work p50 about 4.4 ms, GPU about 4.7 ms), no red log line.
# agl's post effect that samples the attachment it writes (feedback_snap, which the Mac and iPhone need): no snapshot on Android, and none needed on the Adreno: screen
# recordings found no magenta block in any frame. The shader tables are the Windows split's.
# A 30-minute soak in that course (walking and turning the camera): frame time p50 16.55 ms, p95 about 19.3 ms; about a quarter of the 300-frame windows dropped 1-3 frames;
# footprint 654 MiB; one audio window with 7 underruns (35 ms), at startup, none after; no red log line.
# Not tested yet: finishing the opening course (the route to the Power Star was not found by DM_CTL), so the book, saving and loading; the touch pointer; docked mode
